resize_image_tensor: resize a numpy image array to specified height and width using bilinear resampling
normalize_image_values: normalize a numpy image array using mean and standard deviation per channel
convert_bbox_format: convert bounding boxes from center format to corners format or vice versa
pad_image_array: pad a numpy image array with constant, reflect, replicate, or symmetric padding mode
group_images_by_shape: group a list of torch tensors by their shape for efficient batching
